page.notes: The page is a single printed page of text with one heading block. Doubtful readings: the macron on "nō" in the marginal note is read from a small mark and may be an acute or tilde; the spacing in the note ("Ant tiq.", "bell.deOri gin.&") follows the printed line breaks, which are hard to read. "GRONINGA" is set in small capitals within the italic phrase and is copied in roman capitals. The printed hyphen in "Ultraje-ctinæ" is taken from the line end. Spelling of u/v and i/j was normalised in capitals (CUM, ULTRAIECTINIS, URBE, CONIUNCTIONE). The word "succesforesque" is as printed. The small watermark at the bottom right is a digitiser's mark and was left out.
